title: Read back before any change; a read-back held or called ends the turn
situation: An earlier ruling judged the read-back only by its order relative to changes, which made it an ordering and never a handshake, so a read-back followed by a change in the same turn met it.
decision: Reading the instructions, the prompt, the overviews, the journal and the ledger is reconstitution and is never held. At a session's start nothing is recorded or changed before the read-back, which carries the current design, then what is open, then the stories and tasks in flight. A read-back held at a gate or called by the operator ends with the sign-off it waits on and ends its holder's turn until the operator answers; it is met only when no change precedes it and none follows it in the same turn.
consequences: The reconstitution and read-back concepts state this.
